text:
owen: CI on main is red after the lockfile bump from #482, linux wheel build failing during pip install :/
ci-bot: [workflow run] build-linux #1245 failed - artifact: https://ci.example.com/artifacts/1245/build.log
ci-bot: ```ERROR: Could not build wheels for cryptography which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
  Building wheel for cryptography (pyproject.toml) ... error```
maya: ugh. was the lock regen just bumping transitive deps?
sara: yep, #482 ran `poetry lock --no-update` but the poetry lockfile ended up with newer `cffi` and `cryptography` transitive pins from the resolver. Not sure why it pulled newer wheels.
liam: possible transient resolver change or index mirror returned newer sdists. Can someone bisect which commit introduced the bad lock?
owen: requesting bisect: range from 1768200000..1769456123 (last green -> first red). can someone run `git bisect` + build?
maya: I can start it. quick question — does the repro require the manylinux wheel step? or does `pip wheel` fail earlier?
sara: artifact shows failure at `pip wheel cryptography` step. local quick run: `pip install -r requirements.txt --no-binary :all:` fails same error.
liam: try pinning `cryptography==39.0.1` in pyproject temporarily to unblock CI. Command: `poetry add --dev "cryptography==39.0.1" --lock` then push commit to bump lock.
maya: can we avoid adding direct pin to deps? I prefer a temporary CI matrix override: in the workflow, add `PIP_CONSTRAINTS=constraints.txt` step with `cryptography==39.0.1`. less change to project files.
owen: that's a good short-term plan. who can open the quick revert/pr with the constraints?
sara: grabbing it now. will push a small commit that writes constraints.txt and sets env in CI.
ci-bot: started rerun for build-linux with constraints at https://ci.example.com/runs/1246 (queued) :eyes:
maya: parallelly I'll bisect locally to find which commit in the lock regen changed the transitive pin. will report back with commit hash.
liam: if bisect points to poetry/resolver jitter, we might need to pin poetry version in CI to avoid future drift. i can follow up with a ticket.
owen: sounds good. once CI unblocks we can decide whether to keep constraints or actually revert the lock regen and re-run `poetry lock` with locked resolver.
sara: PR up: #489 — adds constraints + CI env var. after CI passes i'll open follow-up to either revert lock or re-generate with POETRY_VERSION pinned.
maya: bisect update: found culprit commit 1769312104 — it changed the extra index config for the resolver, which caused different wheel selection. leaving notes in the bisect run.
owen: thanks @maya, that explains it. assigning follow-up to liam for POETRY_VERSION pin ticket.
liam: on it. creating ticket INFRA-302.
ci-bot: build-linux (run 1246) succeeded ✅
owen: awesome — merging #489 to unblock main. will schedule a proper lock re-gen in a branch where we pin poetry and use the same index. :thumbsup:
